name: han-script-lint
description: Detect mixed Simplified and Traditional Chinese in Markdown and text files, and list off-script characters in the Problems panel.

enumDescriptions: Infer the majority script from exclusive characters and only report the minority (a tie reports both).
Report exclusive Simplified characters (for Traditional Chinese writing). Alias: zh-Hant.
Same as traditional (IETF language tag for Traditional Chinese).
Report exclusive Traditional characters (for Simplified Chinese writing). Alias: zh-Hans.
Same as simplified (IETF language tag for Simplified Chinese).
hanScriptLint.targetScript.description: Target written standard. auto uses a majority vote of exclusive characters and only flags the minority script.

hanScriptLint.ignoredCharacters.default: 台里后面只于并才云谷松范余涂姜冲准系板斗丑占干了
hanScriptLint.ignoredCharacters.description: Characters that should not be treated as exclusive Simplified or Traditional evidence. The default covers common one-to-many mappings such as 台/臺 and 里/裏.

hanScriptLint.lintOnOpen.description: Lint Markdown and plain text files when they are opened.

hanScriptLint.lintOnChange.description: Re-lint the active editor while you type (debounced).

hanScriptLint.lintOnSave.description: Re-lint a file when it is saved.

hanScriptLint.maxWorkspaceFiles.description: Maximum number of text files to scan in a workspace scan.
